title: Calendar page — second hand
question: Fresh structures, same world. Lock one, steer, or re-roll again.

options.label: Area lanes across the week
options.lineage: a training log ruled by discipline: one row per area, one column per day
options.thesis: Rows are areas (Appointments, Training, Study), columns are days; you see at once which days carry a workout or a study block, and filtering by area is just hiding a row.
materials: ruled ledger rows, one per area
serif row labels in the left margin
tinted entry chips in day cells
options.viewport: Band: wordmark, week title, prev/today/next, New entry. Paper: a ruled table, seven day columns headed by serif day names and figures, three area rows (Appointments, Training, Study) with their chips in the cells; today's column is tinted and its heading oxblood. Beneath, the selected day's hour timeline card (as on the home) and the inline add form side by side.
options.risk: No hour axis in the grid, so overlaps and free time only show once you select a day.

regions.label: band: week title · prev/next · New entry

options.label: Free time first
options.lineage: a booking sheet where the open slots are what you read
options.thesis: The week is a 7-column hour grid, but the drawn objects are the gaps: free stretches are tinted paper blocks with their length written on them, while events are quiet ruled outlines. The question the page answers is 'when can I fit this?'
materials: one white card, seven day columns × hours
free blocks in warm paper tint with serif duration
events as hairline outlines with small labels
options.viewport: Band: wordmark, week title, prev/today/next, area filters, New entry. Paper: a wide card, day columns 08–20, free stretches drawn as tinted blocks labelled '2 h 30', events as outlined rectangles; clicking a free block opens the add form pre-filled with that slot, in a right-hand column that otherwise shows the selected day's ledger.
options.risk: Inverts the convention; someone glancing for their appointments has to read the quiet layer. Strong for planning, weaker for recall.

options.label: Week grid with a day ledger
options.lineage: the familiar week view, set in this world
options.thesis: Seven day columns over an hour rail in one white card, events as tinted blocks, today's column tinted; the selected day's ruled ledger and the add form sit in a right column. The canon of the category, executed in the agenda's materials.
materials: serif day headings with oldstyle figures
options.viewport: Band: wordmark, week title, prev/today/next, area filters, New entry. Paper: the week card takes 8/12 with day headings (Mon 14 … Sun 20), hour rail at left, blocks per area, today tinted with an oxblood now-line; right 4/12 the selected day's ledger rows and the inline add form.
options.risk: The most familiar of the hands; earns its place on clarity rather than surprise.
